shortDescription: Bloomberg ETF analyst James Seyffart compiled 13F data showing that, as of June 30, 30 known institutions held three Hyperliquid ETFs. According to PANews, the combined holdings were about $74,882,768, representing roughly 1,151,386 HYPE.
